title: Valid Square
goal: Determine whether four unordered points are the vertices of a nondegenerate square.
strategy: A square has four equal positive squared side lengths and two equal squared diagonals, each twice the side value. All six pair distances avoid guessing vertex order and avoid floating-point roots.
